desc: High quality components and precise manufacturing make BCM firearms ideal for both new shooters and experienced gun owners. The durability, reliability and excellent build quality will ensure years of service you can count on. This Recce-18 Precision Rifle comes equipped with a 15" MCMR free floating M-LOK handguard, BCM Gunfighter charging handle, A2 flash hider and BCM pistol grip/buttstock.
